question: Renowned violinist ____ trained in Carnatic music as well as Western classical music.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshminarayana Subramaniam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Dr. L. Subramaniam

 
 
• He is a reputed Tamil violinist, and composer. 
 
• He has extensive training in Carnatic and Western classical music and made his mark in fusion orchestral music compositions.
 
• He was born into a Tamil family of established musicians.
 
• His father V.Lakshminarayana and his mother V.Seethalakshmi have accomplished musicians of their time.
